evidence: The Core parser retains exact original text and a deterministic normalized form with typed immutable AST and schema/grammar/analyzer identities. All named fields, literal/phrase/Boolean/year filters, precedence and canonical roundtrips are exercised. Syntax diagnostics use original-relative half-open codepoint spans with CRLF, EOF and astral cases. The architecture guide documents the exact grammar, limits and analyzer distinction.

Fresh verbose search tests cover valid Core/JSON/schema roundtrip, isolated UI/server-free execution, snapshot substitutions, strict decoding, exact and over-limit boundaries, forged cycles/expanded aliases/partial construction, immutable children and safe error representations/chaining. The UTF8 predecode regression failed before its fix and now passes. Selected existing service tests exercise an actual authenticated ephemeral numeric-loopback listener and typed runtime/OpenAPI compatibility; no standalone production launcher or native-supervisor proof is inferred.

Exactly three portable search schemas are additive through the existing generator. All36 predecessor generated artifacts are freshly byte-identical to the authenticated actual f295 inventory; the committed predecessor fixture also preserves102 OpenAPI method/path/operation identities while allowing future additive operations. Existing connector DTO and HTTP/client bytes remain unchanged in this task.

Core/documentation/contracts and all six new Python sources/tests are registered in existing quality controls. Proposed ADR0059 documents routine implementation under Accepted0057/CAP06-D01/D06 without changing their authority. This pure contract task has no persistent mutation, migration, SQL/index, operational audit event or governed UI change; those remain in T02/T03 and their owning tasks. Normal campaign/claim views and exact historical-page retention are disclosed separately in the publication note.

Tests roundtrip all field/filter and quoted/literal/Boolean forms with unchanged Unicode and original text. Limits cover8192 original/normalized codepoints,16 syntax/AST levels,256 expanded nodes,32 operands and262144 UTF8 wire bytes, including at-cap acceptance and material cap+1 rejection. Wire container/UTF8/byte preflight precedes recursive JSON decoding. Unknown schema/grammar/analyzer/fields/kinds, duplicates and coercive/Boolean years fail closed.
